topic: M-RND-04: native kind-6 polygon projected-vertex preparation on integrated original vehicle geometry
summary: Removes only the kind-6 callback substitute at 0047C8D0 from the accepted PR #70 continuous original-instruction path; captures native output, a behind-camera negative and independent fresh-GZF-project repeat. Kind 10 and draw remain substituted.

validation.notes: Standalone verifier validates native 0047C8D0 output and return across two kind-6 quads, source preservation, finite projected/depth fields, destination mutation, fresh imported GZF repeat, ownership chain, negative no-submission case, preserved substitutes and exact instruction anchors. Separately reran accepted PR #70 full verifier (1402 assertions, 5 cases) before this experiment.

methods: Reproduced accepted PR #70 end-to-end driver from a new private project; full verifier passed 1402 assertions across five processes.
Ran copied probe in one emulator per case, preserving original construction/registration, camera, producer/consumer, GEO traversal and polygon wrapper chronology.
Removed only kind-6 clip/prepare substitute; retained kind-10 clip and all draw/material/device service substitutions.
Captured callback arguments, source/destination bytes and original return EAX; instruction output stores independently inspected from retail source listing.
Ran behind-camera negative in a separate emulator process and visible repeat after importing GZF into a new private Ghidra project.
Standalone verifier rechecks committed bounded events and instruction excerpt.
reproducibility.limitations: Ghidra EmulatorHelper execution, not native hardware/game runtime. Controlled scene pose/view/depth and accepted harness resource/CRT/OS/allocator services remain. The observed 0047C8D0 routine performs projection/preparation without creating a clipped intersection in this case. Kind-10 clip and both drawing callbacks remain substituted. No framebuffer, pixel, terrain or hardware raster claim. Licensed EXE/ZFS/GZF and project remain private; one inherited uninitialized read warning at 004461E0 during vehicle setup.
